description: When a Bill review, Invoice review, Invoice to send or Client bill approval form is submitted, applies the decision in the client’s Xero organisation: approve (with any changes), reject, or ask the client. Approved sales invoices go to Awaiting payment; Xero emails a raised invoice to the customer only when the reviewer says so. Bills over the client-approval limit get a follow-up item with a draft email. Coding changes are remembered for the supplier or customer.
